summary: Doubles the initial wake-up/detection distance of 37 enemy types (94 thresholds in 23 stage overlays), so they notice Alucard from twice as far away.

detection.detail: Every edit differs from off ONLY in its low halfword (the immediate), and those halfwords are all tunable. Recognise each site by its fixed upper halfword (file bytes +2..+3, opcode+registers: 0x2842 = slti v0,v0 / 0x2A10 = slti s0,s0 / 0x3402 = ori v0,zero) which is identical in on and off. Treat the hack as ON when the fixed halfwords match at (nearly) all 94 sites and the immediate differs from the off immediate at a majority of them (suggest >= 48 of 94); OFF when all immediates equal off. Turning it off writes the full off word; turning it on writes the on word (current doubled values).

display.detail: Optional: show average on/off immediate ratio (currently exactly 2.0x at every site).

overlaps.detail: No other hack in the list (or any other user PPF) writes these 94 words or any byte within +-16 of them; the only o->a diffs within +-64 bytes are other Double-Aggro sites.

The Reawakened PPF (source of the MiniMap/Fast Warp ports) also raises 24 of these same thresholds (e.g. Bat 0x60->0xC0, Discus Lord 0x80->0xD8). That part of Reawakened was not ported into ASS 2.0 (bytes equal Double-Aggro values), so no conflict; if it is ever ported the sites would still detect as ON because the immediates differ from vanilla.

notes: Source: SOTN-Alternate-Scarlet-Symphony-2.0-Double-Aggro.ppf + SOTN-Double-Aggro-CHANGES.md (Codex 2026-09-26/referenced-chatgpt-conversation-this-is-an-3). Every row of the CHANGES table was re-checked: v == o == documented old word, a == documented new word (images t and b also carry the new words), raw BIN offsets match. 91 sites are `slti` comparisons right after the distance helpers (e.g. jal 0x801BBDEC / 0x801BBE28 in ARE); 3 are `ori` spawn-time initialisers (RCAT Bat X/Y at 0x33CE4/0x33CDC, RCHI Bat X+Y at 0x1A984). All are code in stage overlays (not entity layout data), so offsets do not move when the map editor re-packs layouts. Doubled values fit the signed 16-bit immediates (max 384). Off = vanilla = ASS 1.3.1 bytes. In-game reach can still be limited by room spawning/culling (per the patch README).
